decisions.summary: Minseo Park decided that Daniel Cho takes over all open Daehan Precision and Seoul Medica import files from 2026-07-01 as single point of contact, following Jiwoo Han's departure on 30 June.

tasks.summary: Jiwoo Han to prepare handover notes for Daniel Cho covering open tasks, carrier and broker contacts, and watch-outs for the Daehan Precision and Seoul Medica files.
Daniel Cho to block time with Jiwoo Han to go through the handover.
Daniel Cho to ensure the Arrival Notice for S-025 is sent to the consignee ahead of arrival.
Daniel Cho to keep chasing the outstanding POD for S-024 so the file can be closed.

deadlines.what: Jiwoo Han's last day; handover to Daniel Cho must be completed before she leaves.
